name: Cash-Secured Put Ladder
summary: Sell multiple cash-secured puts at descending strikes and staggered expiries so the system scales into shares gradually as the underlying falls.
max_loss: sum of (strike - credit) x 100 across all rungs
breakevens: per rung: strike - credit; blended basis if all are assigned
when_to_use: A high-conviction long-term underlying where the system wants to build a position on weakness, with IV Rank >= 30. This is the natural options analogue of the tick-averager DCA ladder.
entry_rules: Total cash reserved = sum(strike x 100) across all rungs; require that total <= 25% of account equity for one underlying.
Each rung independently passes the CSP gates (IVR >= 30, OI >= 250, credit >= 1% of strike notional annualized >= 12%).
Strikes separated by at least 1 x ATR(14) or 3% of spot, whichever is greater.
No two rungs in the same expiry.
management_rules: Manage each rung at 50% profit / 21 DTE independently.
When a rung closes, re-open at the furthest expiry to keep the ladder shape.
Halt new rungs if aggregate short put delta across the underlying exceeds 0.80 per $10k of allocated capital.
If the underlying drops through two rungs, stop adding and shift to defense (roll down and out the deepest rung).
exit_rules: Per-rung hard guard: ITM short put closed by 15:30 ET on its expiration day; shares purchased deliberately in the open market if wanted.
Any rung with extrinsic < 0.05 and delta < -0.85 is closed the same session.
Whole-ladder kill switch: if the aggregate unrealized loss exceeds 4% of account equity, close all rungs.
assignment_risk: Each rung is independently assignable; the real hazard is CORRELATED assignment - a sharp selloff can put all three rungs ITM at once, demanding the full cash reserve in one day. The ladder must be sized assuming every rung is assigned simultaneously.
buying_power: Sum of all strikes x 100, reserved in cash.
liquidity_needs: Multiple liquid expiries and strikes; OI >= 250 per rung.
common_mistakes: Sizing each rung as if only one will be assigned; adding rungs into a downtrend without a trend filter; stacking all rungs in the same expiry so they all resolve together.
zero_dte_notes: The ladder is about time and price diversification; a 0DTE rung contributes almost no premium and all the gamma.
family: Stock/ETF Shares Combined With Options (covered writes, protective hedges, collars, synthetics, repairs, conversions)
